task.text: Each approval rule is buried in the nesting of one method.
Turn the rules into a **chain of responsibility**. `ApprovalService.approve(Expense)` must return exactly what it returns now, and `Expense` stays as it is.

items: `interface Approver` with one method, `Optional<String> decide(Expense)`: empty means "not mine, pass it on".
`ApprovalChain(List<Approver>)` with `String approve(Expense)`: the first present answer wins; if nobody answers, `escalate:board`.
`ApprovalChain` knows no rules; each rule lives in an `Approver`.
`ApprovalService` delegates to a chain and keeps it in a field and decides nothing itself.

checks.title: Bigger expenses climb to manager, director, board
The chain asks links in order and stops at an answer
An unanswered request goes to the board

hints.text: Every rule has the same shape: look at the expense, then either decide or say "not mine". Name that shape, and the nesting turns into a sequence.

Write `Approver` returning `Optional<String>`. Give `ApprovalChain` a list of approvers and loop until one answers. Build the standard chain, gift rule first, in `Approvals.standard()`; `ApprovalService` holds that chain.
